jobs.title: Environmental Health Officer
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 003546

Agency: Department of Health

Number of Vacancies: 1

Work Unit: Environmental Health Operations

Location: Alice Springs

Primary Objective: Plan, develop and undertake community environmental health promotion and enforcement programs and activities to protect the public from physical, chemical and biological agents in the environment, which may adversely impact on human health.

Contact: Sonny McKay on 0436 619 659 or sonny.mckay@nt.gov.au

Remuneration Package: Remuneration Package $113,101 - $134,507 (including salary $95,697 - $114,104)

Experience Level: Professional 2
